title: LocalFlow M01–M14 Cross-Milestone Adversarial Corpus
source: Read-only GitHub source review and synthetic proposed witnesses; no user data.
binding_policy: Local agent must inventory actual tracked callers, bind drivers to the frozen audited base, and independently reproduce allegations before edits. Names describing seams are specifications, not invented existing APIs.

isolation.fixtures: Synthetic clocks, job IDs, texts, controlled worker outputs, owned targets, temporary managed roots and sibling sentinels.

findings.title: Current-version repair does not protect the later relational families
Transform revision numbers can name a history payload different from the live definition
Retry examples can inflate Your Voice’s logical-dictation count and interpretation floor
Speech-derived technical terms are renamed through current vocabulary state
Transforms Update submits a stale full form without revision admission
Transforms Add reports an admitted timeout as not saved and retries with a new identity
A training refresh can erase the completed Export Validate result
STATUS mixes implementation-era details with current campaign state

cases.title: Current-version repair does not protect the later relational families
cases.setup: Freeze audited base; create only synthetic stores, clocks, hosts and file roots.
actions: Create a synthetic current-version store through supported services; create at least 10 families, mark a chosen family exposed, and keep the assignment rows.
Close cleanly, copy the store, drop only training_memberships in the copy, then reopen through the normal migration/backup route.
Assign again with a fixed seed that would put the selected family into frozen_test if its exposure history were absent; inspect the resulting qualification.

In separate copies, drop profile_evidence while retaining a current supported snapshot. For learning_vocabulary_deltas, first approve a created entry and then user-edit its canonical name without changing the single approved alias; drop the delta table, reopen and invoke undo.
cases.independent_oracle: Fail closed with a recoverable corruption report and untouched backup, or reconstruct the entire lost authority from an independently sufficient canonical source. Never silently call the relational family intact.
cases.predicted_base_behavior: Static repair permits the tables to be recreated empty. Exposure can then be forgotten, missing support links defeat link-driven invalidation, and undo with no delta falls back to revision_after_approval=None. For a created rule whose alias/enabled fields still match, that fallback can disable the later user-edited entry. All local witnesses remain NOT_RUN.
cases.control: An ordinary sequential, in-policy run must succeed; intentionally stale or reduced-authority variants must not acquire new capability.

metamorphic_relations.independent_relation: Original capture instant, family and provenance cannot be rewritten

metamorphic_relations.name: Usage independence
metamorphic_relations.independent_relation: No recreation or invented facts in the other domain

metamorphic_relations.name: Exposure
metamorphic_relations.perturbation: Add known exposure in any assignment

metamorphic_relations.name: Query generation
metamorphic_relations.perturbation: Deliver an older async result later
metamorphic_relations.independent_relation: It cannot overwrite newer user state

metamorphic_relations.name: Export isolation
metamorphic_relations.perturbation: Remove one selected or one unrelated source
metamorphic_relations.independent_relation: Only dependent records/builds are affected; unrelated deletion is not a blanket abort
